_note: Fixed, self-contained prompt set for the CAVEMAX benchmark (see docs/BENCHMARKS.md). Prompts only — no results are stored here. Do not edit prompts after publishing results for a run; add a new version instead.

prompts.prompt: My Express route `/users` takes 4s with 100 users and my logs show 101 SQL queries per request. What is wrong and how do I fix it?
`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')` is thrown in my React component when the API response is still loading. Why and how do I fix it?
My Node 20 script prints `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for './utils' even though utils.js exists next to it. package.json has "type": "module". What is the cause?
A Python loop `for i in range(len(xs)): xs.remove(xs[i])` raises IndexError. Explain why and give a fix.
My Dockerfile build says `COPY failed: file not found in build context or excluded by .dockerignore: stat package.json`. What should I check?
A JWT expiry check uses `if (token.exp < now)` and tokens are accepted for one extra second after expiry. Is this a bug? What is the correct comparison?
My Go program deadlocks with `fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!` when I send on an unbuffered channel in main. Why?
CSS `position: sticky` does nothing on my header. List the most likely causes in order of probability.
Write a TypeScript function that debounces another function, with a `cancel()` method.
Write a Python function that returns the n most frequent words in a text file, ignoring case and punctuation.
Write a SQL query returning the top 3 customers by total order value per country from tables `customers(id, country)` and `orders(id, customer_id, total)`.
Write a bash one-liner that finds the 10 largest files under the current directory.
Write a Rust function that parses a semver string like `1.2.3` into a `(u32, u32, u32)` tuple and returns an error for bad input.
Write a React hook `useLocalStorage(key, initial)` that stays in sync across tabs.
Write a Go HTTP middleware that logs method, path and duration of each request.
Write a regex that matches ISO 8601 dates like 2026-10-06 and explain each part briefly.

Refactor this to remove the nested ifs:

```js
function f(u){ if(u){ if(u.active){ if(u.email){ return send(u.email); } } } return null; }
```

Convert this callback code to async/await:

```js
fs.readFile(p, 'utf8', (err, d) => { if (err) return cb(err); parse(d, (e, r) => cb(e, r)); });
```
This Python class has 12 methods that all take the same 5 parameters. How would you refactor it?

Replace this switch on `type` with a lookup table in TypeScript and say what you gain:

```ts
switch (type) { case 'a': return fa(x); case 'b': return fb(x); default: throw new Error('bad'); }
```
I have a 900-line `utils.js` that everything imports. Give a safe step-by-step plan to split it.
Should I extract this duplicated 6-line block that appears 3 times with small differences? How do I decide?
Rewrite `for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { out.push(arr[i] * 2); }` in modern JavaScript.
Explain database connection pooling and why it helps.
Why does my React component re-render on every parent update even though its props look unchanged?
Explain the difference between `git merge` and `git rebase` and when to use each.
What is the event loop in Node.js and why does a long synchronous loop block it?
Explain what a race condition is with a concrete example in JavaScript.
What is the difference between a process and a thread?
Explain CORS: why does my browser block my fetch call to localhost:8000 from localhost:3000?
How do I undo my last commit but keep the changes staged?
How do I find which process is listening on port 3000 on Linux and kill it?
How do I recursively replace `foo` with `bar` in all `.ts` files under src/?
My `npm install` fails with `EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/usr/local/lib/node_modules'`. How do I fix it without sudo?
How do I see why a Docker container exited with code 137?
How do I tail a log file and only show lines containing ERROR?
Give me a command to delete all `node_modules` directories under the current folder. It is destructive; say what I should check first.
Is this SQL safe? `db.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + req.params.id)` Explain and fix it.
I want to store user passwords. What should I use and what parameters?
I accidentally committed an AWS secret key to a public repo. What do I do, in order?
Explain XSS and the most reliable way to prevent it in a React app.
Should I run `curl https://example.com/install.sh | sudo bash`? What are the risks?
Review this for security problems: `app.get('/file', (req, res) => res.sendFile('/data/' + req.query.name))`
Is it OK to store a JWT in localStorage? Compare with httpOnly cookies.
Should I use a monolith or microservices for a 3-person team building a SaaS MVP?
When should I add a cache in front of my database, and what are the invalidation risks?
Design a rate limiter for an API: compare fixed window, sliding window and token bucket.
How should I structure a monorepo with a web app, an API and a shared types package?
Queue vs. cron for sending 50,000 emails per night: which and why?
How do I make a payment webhook handler idempotent?
